now-sdk cicd test <command>

sn_cicd single-test operations

Commands:
  now-sdk cicd test run     Run a single ATF test on the instance and wait for
                            its pass/fail result
  now-sdk cicd test watch   Wait for a previously started single ATF test run to
                            finish, polling for its pass/fail result
  now-sdk cicd test result  Fetch a single ATF test's result (status, output,
                            link) by its result id
  now-sdk cicd test logs    Fetch an ATF test result's logs, optionally filtered
                            by a regular expression

Options:
  -d, --debug    Print debug output                   [boolean] [default: false]
  -h, --help     Show help                                             [boolean]
  -v, --version  Show version number                                   [boolean]
